finalists.label: Intussusception
finalists.why: It has specific evidence including air–fluid levels in the small bowel and dilated large-bowel loops, and a 5-cm hyperechoic mass in the hypogastric region surrounded by intestinal loops.

finalists.label: Gastroenteritis
finalists.why: It explains the symptoms of generalized abdominal pain, fever, and vomiting, although it lacks specific findings like a mass or air-fluid levels.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a 5-cm hyperechoic mass in the hypogastric region surrounded by intestinal loops and air–fluid levels in the small bowel and dilated large-bowel loops specifically supports Intussusception over the more general symptoms explained by Gastroenteritis.
